title: merchant.fact.application_decided v1 payload
description: ADR-0011 M1 — Merchant-owned outcome of a merchant-status application (v6.3 p.9). Carries no application content: the answers a merchant supplies are business PII and stay behind Merchant's API. The review reason is deliberately excluded for the same reason.

application_id.description: MerchantApplication aggregate id; MUST equal envelope aggregate_id.

applicant_principal_id.description: Identity principal that applied. A rejected applicant stays a regular customer (v6.3 p.9).

decision.description: CHANGES_REQUESTED is not a final rejection — the applicant may edit and resubmit.

merchant_id.description: Present only for APPROVED: the merchant created by the approval.

merchant_code.description: Present only for APPROVED. Quoted to support and printed on labels.
